pages.title: Quine
pages.reaction: A program that prints itself, and the trick is one string used twice, once as code and once as data. pages.title: Self-reproducing object
pages.reaction: A quine fitting in a fish is a lovely bit of nonsense. This page is mostly Hofstadter's taxonomy: Gödel quines, error quines named after Scott Kim, and ganguines that guess their own source until they stumble into it.
